integrated.title: EWI-4b: Feynman-gauge loops
integrated.detail: electroweak requests take the model in 't Hooft-Feynman gauge throughout (loops, counterterms, trees; a model that cannot take gauge 1 is refused when the request is prepared, visible in the dry run); Goldstone-vector mixing counterterms lowered as vertex insertions; QCD-only requests keep the compiled gauge (plans byte-identical); g g > t t~ (EW) equals MadLoop at point 0 within 1e-12 per coefficient

integrated.title: B phase 1: native seed tables
integrated.detail: the seed tables are built in Rust on the production route (main slice, poles companion, LC/NLC and observable prunes; any native failure fails closed, the Python stage kept as oracle), with a retained arena and the exact colour-network reductions in-crate; seven-leg plan digests unchanged; the 43,200 generic companion seeds of g g > g g g g g equal the Python ones (2.69 s against 260.9 s); new native build

integrated.title: C phase 1: native colour cells
integrated.detail: colour cells, seed records, overlap degrees and dipole orbits in Rust on the production route (the Python stages as oracles, no per-request fallback); the stored dipole orbits are validated before allocation (typed refusals); seven-leg stored forms keep their digests; new native build

integrated.title: Genericity audit M3 and minors
integrated.detail: coupling-order names resolve once, case-insensitively, against the model's declared names (M3); structural colour-singlet and neutral-QCD counterterm certificates (no PDG allowlist); validation momenta from the model's masses; a renamed-model harness (orders, particles, PDG codes, parameters) as a durable test

integrated.title: EWI-6b: external photons at α(0)
integrated.detail: on-shell external photons of EW requests take alpha(0) (every output scaled by (alpha(0)/alpha_Gmu)^n with MG5_aMC's per-photon DGmua0 field term; typed refusals otherwise); mixed QCD x EW sectors predicted only where the requested corrections complete their loops; Catani beta_0 and gamma_j from the request's species (genericity m1, m3); stored artifacts of external-photon requests wait for EW native inputs (EWI-N)

integrated.title: Arbitrary fermion lines
integrated.detail: any number of coloured fermion lines, identical or distinct flavours, QCD and EW, in the loop recursion (the fold of mixed colour-connection parities runs before the evaluation reuse in the Python and Rust lanes; native fast paths output-identical); u u~ > d d~ s s~, u u~ > u u~ d d~, u u~ > u u~ u u~ and u u~ > u u~ e+ e- equal MadLoop in quadruple precision and Recola; new native build

integrated.title: Generation at scale
integrated.detail: no call of a stored process regenerates (every pole selection, correlated, resolved, flavour and catalogue calls; a process the native export cannot store fails its generation with a typed refusal, genericity M1); a lean poles companion; the native finite-only skip from the I5 interaction record; derived masses bound by the parameter program (M2); the SDK v4 runtime with the "uv"/"ir" pole selections, bitwise the Python API; declared NLO dipoles at +10 % of the six-gluon generation; new native build

already_on_loop: v2 waves 0-1 (gates S1, G0), native executor, colour, stability API, schedule M, observables, NJet reference, public v2 engine with plan v4 artifacts, counterterms as plain tree insertions (addendum J), runtime pole selection, Rust A0-A3, the G1 harness, G-int (native per-point inputs and generation stages), the summary-first report; at milestone m1025a ct-perf, ew-poles (EW guards, QED Catani operator), lc-perf, artifact-portability and ew-lines; at m1025c native-dag A4, ew-gauge EWI-4a, precision-ap, ew-ct EWI-0/EWI-3, measure-g1-7leg (G1 at 2->5), reference-relocate, model-determinism, native-lowering D phase 1 part 1 and onshell-consistency
